responsibility: Defines the FR-V backend’s machine constraints for reload, instruction selection, and asm operands. It maps constraint letters to FR-V register classes such as GPR/FPR/ACC/condition-code/FDPIC-specific registers, and specifies the immediate, symbolic, relocation, and memory forms accepted by FR-V patterns, including 6/10/12/16-bit integer ranges, GOT12 relocations, call symbols, conditional-execution memory operands, and one- vs two-instruction doubleword memory accesses.
